summary: Iteration 90 - Payroll/Timeclock Shift Deletion Fix & Floating Assistant Drag/Right-Click Features. All features verified working: (1) Deleting timeclock shifts now also deletes underlying raw timelogs preventing resurrection on backfill, (2) Floating assistant can be drag-moved by header, (3) Floating assistant closes on right-click of header.
seed_data_creation: Test employees created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 90 fixes verified: (1) DELETE /api/payroll/timeclock-shifts/{shift_id} now deletes matching raw timelogs before removing the normalized shift, preventing the shift from being auto-backfilled again. (2) FloatingAssistant.js now supports drag-move via header mousedown/mousemove and right-click close via onContextMenu. All payroll tabs (Overview, Time Sheets, Time Entries, Transactions, Schedule) are functional.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Incorrect payroll/timeclock entries reappear after deletion (example: repeated $750 employee amount)
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Deleting a normalized timeclock shift did not delete the underlying raw timelogs, so the next fetch/backfill recreated the shift
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: DELETE /api/payroll/timeclock-shifts/{shift_id} now deletes corresponding raw timelogs (db.timelogs.delete_many) before removing the normalized shift
